components.title: Filter and deduplicate orders
components.what: Remove exact duplicate rows from the orders table first, then extract distinct orders with order_date between 2026-05-12 and 2026-06-10 inclusive, regardless of status.

components.title: Compute median unit price
components.what: Sort the unit_price values of the filtered, deduplicated orders and calculate the median, rounding to two decimal places.

challenges.problem: O2006 dated 2026-06-02 is omitted; its unit_price is 77.67. The correct count is 28 distinct orders after removing the exact duplicates.
O2058 is duplicated but falls outside the date range, so removing it does not affect the filtered set; O2385 and O2705 are the duplicates that affect the 27-order filtered count.

challenges.problem: The draft's order list isn't shown explicitly (only the price list), so the panel can't verify which 27 order_ids were included without re-deriving them; an independent recount of all order_ids by date is needed to confirm none outside duplicates (e.g. O2250 dated 2026-05-10, O2141 05-05, O2141 outside) were mistakenly included or a valid order (e.g. O2884 06-09, 61.78) was dropped.
For n=27 (odd), median is indeed position (27+1)/2=14, which is correct arithmetic, but this depends entirely on the unverified 27-item list being complete and correctly sorted.

The sorted list includes values from orders outside the date window (e.g., 20.76 from O2636 is 2026-05-30, which is inside; but 46.84 from O2474 is 2026-05-29, inside; 16.42 from O2842 is 2026-06-02, inside) and omits values from orders inside the window. The list appears to be missing 110.48 (O2307, 2026-06-23 - outside window, correctly excluded) but includes 104.22 (O2427, 2026-05-13, inside). However, 32.34 (O2718, 2026-05-12, inside) is included, but 94.71 (O2408, 2026-04-29, outside) is correctly excluded. The main issue is the count mismatch leading to wrong median position.
If the correct count is 26 (not 27), the median is the average of the 13th and 14th values, not simply the 14th value. The current draft's median calculation depends entirely on the incorrect count.
